body:
Follow-up from #458 and its Claude diagnosis/design review (`docs/qa/2026-11-13-launcher-timeouts/claude-diagnosis.md`).

Root cause: Windows launcher timeout cleanup terminates its own read-only Node helper, not descendants. If that helper has started a PowerShell/WMI query, terminating Node also removes the Node-side execFile timeout; a stuck query can outlive the launcher. This is a pre-existing lifecycle limitation, not evidence that the owner's November 13 failures involved WMI. Event history for that incident showed no WMI starts during the failures.

Disposition: DEFER-ISSUE (P2), non-blocking for the bounded pipe/deadline repair. A job-object or equivalent owned-process-tree lifecycle needs a separate reviewed native-process change. The current repair explicitly refuses uncertain ownership and neither kills arbitrary descendants nor claims complete tree cleanup.

Acceptance:
- Establish ownership of any helper descendants before terminating them; never target a reused/unrelated PID, gateway, provider process, or owner session.
- A fixture PowerShell query that outlives the helper's deadline is collected within a bounded cleanup allowance, including immediate helper exit and nested descendants.
- Preserve actual WMI process creation identity, shared fail-closed ownership, process/EOF deadlines and no raw output disclosure.
- Native Windows tests prove cleanup, unrelated-process survival and no ownership file mutation on refusal. Keep ordinary helper success and gateway detached lifetime covered.
- Document OS/job nesting constraints; no service supervisor, permission changes or store reset.

Dedup: searched launcher issues and job-object/helper-descendant/orphaned-PowerShell terms; no existing matching root cause found. Parked under backlog; this ticket is not implementation dispatch.

## Delivery

The owner admitted U3.1 after [intent 2 delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7032804362) on main at `8181f350028e284529c76b51927f32890afcb68a`. The parking text above records the earlier disposition.

GPT architecture, with independent Claude Fable design critique. GPT 6.1 Sol xhigh implements after human approval and independent Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh reviews.

**Independent QA agent** — i3_native_lifecycle_qa (independent Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh). Use native Windows fixtures for ordinary success, bounded nested cleanup, early exits, containment refusal, unrelated process survival and detached gateway lifetime. Begin with the architecture plan on main. The held PR #460 remains under its own owner gate.

Retain the registered touched-system, independent review, final audit, CI and merge gates.


## Engineering delivered — owner review and visual QA remain

PR #541 merged as `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`. The coordinator verified the GitHub signature, ordered parents `47ca4640793a81efa5bec661dba25627de314774` and `2854c5f0df468199083142ee10dda9fc2e2d6a8b`, and tested tree `d289bb12b943557584c5659bc33447d1baebc2f6`. [Capped correction completion and preserved audit history](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/541#issuecomment-7059736744), [independent QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/459#issuecomment-7059318768), and [current CI/native evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/541#issuecomment-7059583337) establish the bounded engineering outcome. D168/D169 accounting and all published limits remain.

The issue remains OPEN and parked to prevent duplicate implementation pickup. D160 reserves consolidated owner decision review and requested rework before owner QA. D164 leaves visible-dialog layout/readability unperformed; source and compiled privacy checks do not replace that observation. This is separate from the delivered engineering work and does not block unrelated intent 4.

Owner QA checklist, after reviewing the decision catalogue:
- Record the selected merged build and Windows environment. Confirm the retained initial 15-second work cap, separate two-second cleanup allowance, and possible refusal on incompatible host job policy are acceptable; request rework if needed.
- In a disposable launcher fixture, inspect a visible bounded failure dialog, including retained held-store guidance. Expect readable text and usable controls, no private helper output or synthetic secret canary, and the same closed diagnostic represented in the bounded log.
- On the approved integrated build, exercise ordinary cold and warm shortcut launches and close the browser. Expect the intended instance to open, warm reuse of that instance and the gateway to remain available after the launcher/browser closes.
- Record observations and any remaining limitations here. Owner closure follows that acceptance; agent evidence does not complete it.

The owner checkout, installed instance, real store and provider sessions were not modified by this delivery. PR #460 remains under its separate hold.
